items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You should try walking after more meals to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise in sugar about 18.3 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Try to keep having dinner before 8 pm, as sugar is linked to a rise about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Having none of your 9 scored dinners start at 8 pm or later is a good habit to continue.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You're doing great with an average overnight fast of 15.9 hours and 100.0% of nights reaching 13 hours. Keeping this habit up is a good idea, as adding an overnight fast to coaching changed some numbers in the program.
